messages:
owen: Heads up — prod-usw2 GPU allocator pool failing to join after the authz TTL tweak. Nodes show PendingJoin. :eyes:

kayla: saw this, noticing `allocator-controller` logs with repeated grant/STS errors. can you paste a snippet?

owen: paste from controller: 
```
ERROR allocator-controller keystore.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: KMS grant expired
status code: 403, request id: a1b2c3d4
time="2026-03-18T14:02:10Z" level=error msg="session token invalid: STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity session expired"
```

jess: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.conditions[?(@.type==\"Ready\")].status}'` shows a bunch of NotReady/Unknown. also saw many join retries in the allocator logs.

kayla: any recent firewall or VPC changes that could cause STS traffic to be dropped?

owen: no firewall rules touched in prod in the last 3 days per change log. security pushed an IAM TTL change yesterday (reduced session duration for ephemeral roles) which might have invalidated existing tokens.

samantha: confirmed — we rolled the session-duration policy to 1h at 2026-03-18T13:00 for tighter compliance. thought existing sessions would be allowed until expiry, but looks like the allocator refresh path expects longer lived grants.

jess: consequence: allocator tries to refresh keystore grants, gets AccessDenied because the grant evaluator denies refresh for near-expiry tokens. prevents node bootstrap (decrypting disk secrets).

ci-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T13:05: keystore/role-ttl-change applied by samantha.

kayla: temporary mitigation options: 1) rollback TTL change, 2) allowlist allocator's assume-role ARN to bypass new evaluator, 3) force restart allocator pods so they pick up new auth flow (may still fail). what's the low-risk fastest?

samantha: we can revert TTL to 12h in 5m, but want to coordinate; reverting removes the compliance guard but restores stability. allowlisting is less invasive if we scope to `role:allocator/*` and region prod-usw2.

owen: prefer allowlist for immediate fix, then plan a safer short-lived-session rollout with allocator code change. I can open a quick PR to authz service to add an exception.

jess: meanwhile we should run a rolling restart of allocator-controller in prod-usw2 so controllers reattempt join after policy change. kayla — can you run the restart after we apply allowlist?

kayla: on it. will do steps: 1) apply allowlist patch 2) scale allocator-controller to 0 then back to desired 3) monitor nodes joining for 10m. posting commands.

kayla: patch command: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap authz-exceptions -p '{"data":{"allocator-assume":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/allocator-prod-usw2"}}'`

owen: restart commands: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy allocator-controller --replicas=0` then `kubectl -n infra scale deploy allocator-controller --replicas=3`

jess: add a metric dashboard panel to watch `gpu_pool_join_rate` and `keystore_decrypt_errors` while we roll.

ci-bot: Change request CR-4981 created by owen: scope=prod-usw2, change=authz allowlist allocator role, rollback_plan=revert configmap entry.

samantha: i applied the authz-exception patch and added a timestamped audit note. keeping the TTL change on hold until postmortem.

kayla: restart done. allocator-controller pods are back up. seeing join events: `2026-03-18T14:04:22 kubelet/RegisterNode success` for 8 nodes so far.

owen: nice. keystore decrypt errors dropping. running a quick sweep: `kubectl logs -n infra allocator-controller | grep Decrypt | wc -l` -> 3 now (down from 180).

jess: cost note — if we keep long sessions for allocator, we slightly increase risk surface but reduces churn/warmup. need to quantify token refresh frequency vs audit sampling. add to follow-up.

samantha: agreed. immediate next steps: (A) keep allowlist for 24h, (B) open ticket for allocator to support short TTLs (token refresh path fix), (C) schedule compliance review for acceptable session durations. I'll own A and C.

owen: i'll file the allocator ticket and draft the long-lived-session vs refresh design doc.

kayla: closing loop: all GPU nodes that were PendingJoin are now Joining/Ready for the pool; monitoring for 60m. will update incident channel if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks team — good catch. we should add this to the runbook: "authz TTL rollouts must coordinate with allocator refresh semantics."

samantha: will add a preflight check to our policy rollout checklist to query `allocator` sessions and kube join windows.

ci-bot: Incident resolved (partial) at 2026-03-18T14:06:40 — auto-note added.
